page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.c1 server family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and running under the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 8 physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. It does not feature any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable performance for CPU-bound tasks.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c1.large is designed for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for applications requiring dedicated physical cores without the overhead of hyperthreading. Appropriate workloads include web serving, batch processing, and lightweight computational tasks.
